children: The Information and Decision Support Center (IDSC) announced the prices of fertilizers and building materials on Sunday, September 20.
A ton of ammonium sulfate hit around EGP 18,537, marking a daily drop of 12.3%.
The price of ammonium nitrate declined by 3.6% to EGP 24,028 per ton.
Urea amounted to EGP 24,595 per ton, falling 3.5% daily.
As for the building materials, grey cement retreated by 1.5% daily to EGP 4,044 per ton.
Similarly, a ton of investment-grade steel went down by 0.2% to EGP 37,690.
Ezz Steel reached EGP 39,768, an increase of 0.4% daily.

title: ZAWYA: Egypt: Prices of fertilizers, building materials down on September 20
